## Change summary

What changed and why? Link the associated issue or decision (if available).

## Source and boundaries

- [ ] Implementation claims were verified against a fixed source revision.
- [ ] No Production/LINE/broker/KV mutation or paid fallback was performed without current authorization.
- [ ] No credentials, account details, user identifiers, private positions or restricted text in the diff/logs.
- [ ] Changes were checked for docs links, source data rights, privacy and rollback requirements.

## Verification evidence

List commands, exit codes and counts; mention focused and full tests as applicable. Explain any omitted, blocked or unavailable test as such. A successful PR is not a live release.

## Review and rollback

Describe risks, falsifiers, compatibility consequences, and the minimal safe rollback.
